message.content: {"stem":"Which epithelial type lines the alveoli and minimizes the diffusion distance for gas exchange?","anchors":[{"source_id":"boundless-anatomy-physiology-2018","locator":"sec21.4A:lungs"}],"options":[{"label":"A","text":"Simple cuboidal epithelium"},{"label":"B","text":"Simple squamous epithelium"},{"label":"C","text":"Stratified squamous epithelium"},{"label":"D","text":"Pseudostratified columnar epithelium"}],"proposed_key":"B","key_explanation":{"text":"Simple squamous epithelium is a single layer of flattened cells; its thinness supports rapid diffusion across the alveolar wall.","anchors":[{"source_id":"boundless-anatomy-physiology-2018","locator":"sec21.4A:lungs"}]},"strongest_distractor":{"text":"Cuboidal and columnar epithelia are thicker and specialized for secretion or absorption, and stratified squamous epithelium is protective rather than optimized for diffusion.","anchors":[{"source_id":"boundless-anatomy-physiology-2018","locator":"sec4.2A:characteristics-of-epithelial-tissue"}]}}
